name: White-rimmed Brushfinch
rangeDescription: Locally in andes of southern colombia and eastern ecuador
description: A rare and striking finch-like bird restricted to cloud forest of the Andes of Ecuador and southern Colombia. It is black with an olive breast and belly and a chestnut crown; the bold, white “spectacles” set it apart from any other bird in range.

name: Slaty-backed Thrush
rangeDescription: Eastern lesser sundas (yamdena and larat)
description: An unmistakable black, white, and gray thrush. Gray upperparts and black head marked with bold white cheek patch and long white eyebrow.

name: Anjouan Scops-Owl
rangeDescription: Anjouan island (comoros)
description: Small, compact dark owl with tiny ear tufts that are often invisible. The overall coloration can be blackish-brown or rufous-brown.

name: Swee Waxbill
rangeDescription: Southern zimbabwe, eastern and southern south africa, eswatini, and lesotho, also far southwestern mozambique (lebombo mountains)
description: A tiny, colorful seed-eating waxbill with grayish underparts, an olive-green back, and a scarlet rump and upper tail. The male has a black throat patch which the female lacks.

name: Reunion Cuckooshrike
rangeDescription: Forest of northwestern réunion (western mascarene islands)
description: Fairly small, slim cuckooshrike in which males and females are strikingly different. Males are mostly gray with black wings and tail.

name: Puna Pipit
rangeDescription: Puna of andes of peru and bolivia
description: Slender brown and buff bird found in dry grasslands in the high Andes. It has a streaked breast and white outer tail feathers that can be conspicuous in flight.

name: Little Nightjar
rangeDescription: Eastern peru to brazil south of the amazon river, uruguay, and northern argentina
description: Small nightjar; streaked gray, brown, and rufous above with a white throat and buff collar. Males have a white wing band near the tip and pale central tail feathers, absent in females.

name: Bocage's Weaver
rangeDescription: Riparian grassland of angola to southeastern democratic republic of the congo and northwestern zambia
description: A fairly large weaver with a long thin pointed bill. The male has a pale eye, and during the breeding season a brownish wash to the ear.

name: Drakensberg Rockjumper
rangeDescription: Rocky montane slopes of lesotho, kwazulu-natal, and eastern cape province
description: A striking, gregarious bird that bounces about on rocky mountain slopes and crags in grassland habitat. The sexes differ: the male has an orange belly and rump, a black throat, and a white moustache; the female is duller, mostly buff underneath with a streaked chest.

name: Black Harrier
rangeDescription: Arid grassland of southern namibia, southwestern botswana, and south africa
description: A striking, mostly dark harrier with large white panels in the underwings, a white rump, and bands on the tail. The juvenile is brown with white flashes in the underwings and has a heavily-streaked chest.

name: Speckle-throated Woodpecker
rangeDescription: Central and eastern tanzania to southeastern malawi and northern mozambique
description: An attractive medium-sized woodpecker with an olive-green back and spotted pale underparts. Males have a red crown, nape, and moustache streak, while females have a black crown, a red nape, and a black-and-white moustache streak.

name: Pohnpei White-eye
rangeDescription: Pohnpei (eastern caroline islands)
description: Small gray bird endemic to Pohnpei, in the Caroline Islands of Micronesia. Uniform plumage makes it unmistakable on the island; Caroline Islands White-eye is yellowish overall, while Long-billed White-eye is greenish with a much longer bill.

name: Dusky Nightjar
rangeDescription: Montane forest of costa rica and western panama
description: Small dark nightjar with very limited range in the highlands of Costa Rica and Panama. Few obvious plumage features: entire body is intricately patterned with dark brown, black, and buff.

name: Hoary-throated Barwing
rangeDescription: Nepal eastward to bhutan and northeastern india (far western arunachal pradesh) and adjacent china (southern xizang)
description: The combination of this barwing’s pale throat and weak eye-arcs is unique. Found in hill forest with dense understory at approximately 1800-3400 meters of elevation; occasionally lower, especially during the winter.

name: Pale Rockfinch
rangeDescription: Arid türkiye; winters to southwestern arabia and northeastern africa
description: A unique passerine that resembles a sparrow, finch, or lark, elongated and neat looking. Very plain overall with pale sandy-gray plumage, two rather prominent whitish wingbars, and a long conical bill.

name: Rufous-fronted Prinia
rangeDescription: Thornscrub of india and pakistan (indus river plain)
description: Sandy-colored warbler with a long tail. Note white underparts, pale eyebrow, and rufous-tinged forecrown.

name: Black-ringed White-eye
rangeDescription: Hills of southwestern sulawesi
description: A small green-backed songbird with a broad black eye patch, a yellow throat and base to undertail, and a white belly. Pairs and small groups can be found in the understory and canopy of forest, forest edge, and scrubby areas in both lowlands and foothills.

name: Bronze-tailed Comet
rangeDescription: Pacific slope of andes of peru
description: Large, long-tailed hummingbird found on scrubby slopes in more arid parts of the Peruvian Andes. Adult male is glistening green with an iridescent rosy throat and bronzy tips to the outer tail feathers.

name: Small Ground-Finch
rangeDescription: Arid scrub of main galapagos islands
description: A small, widespread Galápagos finch. Bill is longer than it is deep, appears somewhat pointed, and has only a slight curve to the upper edge.

name: Fujian Niltava
rangeDescription: Central and southern china; winters to southeastern thailand and indochina
description: A large flycatcher of tropical and subtropical forests. Male is bright blue above with a black face and orange breast and belly which becomes paler toward the vent.
